title.zh: 卷一百三十四 列傳第七十二: 外國上 西夏
title.raw: 卷一百三十四 列傳第七十二: 外國上 西夏 Volume 134 Biographies 72: Foreign Countries 1 - Xixia

sentences.zh: 列傳第七十二 外國上 ○西夏

translations.literal: Biographies 72, Foreign Countries, Upper Section. Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Biography 72: Foreign Countries (Part 1) — Western Xia

sentences.zh: 夏國王李乾順。

translations.literal: The king of the Xia state was Li Qianshun.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Xia was Li Qianshun.

sentences.zh: 其先曰托跋思恭，唐僖宗時，為夏、綏、銀、宥節度使，與李茂貞、李克用等破黃巢，複京師，賜姓李氏。

translations.literal: His ancestor was called Tuoba Sigong; in the time of Emperor Xizong of Tang he was military commissioner of Xia, Sui, Yin, and You, and with Li Maozhen, Li Keyong, and others defeated Huang Chao, recovered the capital, and was granted the surname Li.
translations.idiomatic: His forebear Tuoba Sigong served under Emperor Xizong of Tang as military commissioner of Xia, Sui, Yin, and You. Together with Li Maozhen, Li Keyong, and others he routed Huang Chao, restored the capital, and received the imperial surname Li.

sentences.zh: 唐末，天下大亂，籓鎮連兵，惟夏州未嘗為唐患。

translations.literal: At the end of Tang the realm was in great disorder and frontier governors fought one another in succession, but Xia Prefecture never once became a trouble to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: In the closing years of Tang the empire fell into chaos as military governors warred among themselves, yet Xia Prefecture never troubled the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 曆五代至宋，傳數世至元昊，始稱帝。

translations.literal: Through the Five Dynasties into Song the line was transmitted for several generations until Yuanhao, when he first declared himself emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed through the Five Dynasties and into Song for several generations until Yuanhao, who was the first to proclaim himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 遼人以公主下嫁李氏，世修朝貢不絕，事具《遼史》。

translations.literal: The Khitan of Liao married a princess to the Li house; generation after generation they maintained court tribute without break—the details are in the History of Liao.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao Khitan bestowed a princess on the Li house, and for generations the Xia court kept up tribute and embassies without interruption, as recorded in the History of Liao.

sentences.zh: 天輔六年，金破遼兵，遼主走陰山，夏將李良輔將兵三萬來救遼，次天德境野穀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu, Jin defeated Liao troops; the Liao sovereign fled to the Yin Mountains. The Xia general Li Liangfu led thirty thousand men to rescue Liao, halting at Yegu in the Tiande borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tianfu (1120), Jin routed the Liao armies and the Liao emperor fled toward the Yin Mountains. Xia general Li Liangfu marched thirty thousand troops to Liao's aid and camped at Yegu on the Tiande frontier.

sentences.zh: 斡魯、婁室敗之于宜水，追至野谷，澗水暴至，漂沒者不可勝計。

translations.literal: Wulu and Loushi defeated them at Yishui and pursued them to Yegu; the ravine waters rose suddenly and those swept away and drowned were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Wulu and Loushi defeated them at Yishui and pursued them to Yegu, where flash floods in the ravine drowned countless soldiers.

sentences.zh: 宗望至陰山，以便宜與夏國議和，其書曰：「奉詔有之：夏王，遼之自出，不渝終始，危難相救。

translations.literal: Zongwang reached the Yin Mountains and, exercising discretionary authority, negotiated peace with the Xia state. His letter said: "By imperial order: Xia King—you sprang from Liao itself and have not wavered from first to last, aiding one another in hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang reached the Yin Mountains and, acting on his own authority, opened peace talks with Xia. His letter read: "By imperial command: Xia King—you were born of Liao's own line and have stood firm from beginning to end, rescuing each other in peril.

sentences.zh: 今茲已舉遼國，若能如事遼之日以效職貢，當聽其來，毋致疑貳。

translations.literal: Now that Liao has been overthrown, if you can render duty and tribute as in your days under Liao, you will be allowed to come; do not give cause for doubt and divided loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Liao has been brought down, if you resume tribute and service as you did for Liao, you may present yourself freely—let there be no hint of divided allegiance.

sentences.zh: 若遼主至彼，可令執送。」

translations.literal: If the Liao sovereign comes to your territory, you may have him seized and sent."
translations.idiomatic: Should the Liao emperor reach your realm, seize him and send him to us."

sentences.zh: 天會二年，始奉誓表，以事遼之禮稱籓，請受割賜之地。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianhui they first submitted a sworn memorial, took vassal status in the manner of their service to Liao, and requested the lands granted by partition.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianhui (1124), they first submitted a sworn memorial, accepted vassal status on the Liao model, and asked to receive the territories Jin was granting them.

sentences.zh: 宗翰承制，割下寨以北、陰山以南、乙室耶刮部吐祿濼之西，以賜之。

translations.literal: Zonghan, acting by imperial order, ceded to them the area north of Xia Fortress, south of the Yin Mountains, and west of Tulu Bo of the Yishi Yegua tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan, acting on imperial command, granted them the lands north of Xia Fortress, south of the Yin Mountains, and west of the Tulu Bo marshes of the Yishi Yegua tribe.

sentences.zh: 天會二年三月，乾順遣把裏公亮等來上誓表，曰：「臣乾順言：今月十五日，西南、西北兩路都統遣左諫議大夫王介儒等齎牒奉宣，若夏國追悔前非，捕送遼主，立盟上表，仍依遼國舊制及賜誓詔，將來或有不虞，交相救援者。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Tianhui, Qianshun sent Baligong Liang and others to present the sworn memorial, saying: "Your subject Qianshun submits: On the fifteenth of this month the commanders of the Southwest and Northwest circuits, Left Remonstrating Grandee Wang Jieru and others, delivered an edict proclaiming that if the Xia state repents its former errors, captures and sends the Liao sovereign, establishes alliance and submits a memorial, and still follows the old Liao system and the bestowed sworn edict, then should anything unforeseen arise in future, we shall rescue one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Tianhui 2, Qianshun dispatched Baligong Liang and others with the sworn memorial: "Your subject Qianshun reports: On the fifteenth of this month Wang Jieru, Left Remonstrating Grandee, and others bearing documents from the Southwest and Northwest circuit commanders announced that if Xia repents its past offenses, captures and delivers the Liao emperor, seals alliance in writing, and keeps to the old Liao protocols and the sworn edict Jin has granted, then in any future emergency we shall aid each other.

sentences.zh: 臣與遼國世通姻契，名系籓臣，輒為援以啟端，曾犯威而結釁。

translations.literal: Your subject and the Liao state have been linked by marriage for generations; by title your subject was a vassal, yet acting as their ally opened hostilities and offended Majesty to forge enmity.
translations.idiomatic: My house and Liao have been joined by marriage for generations; I was registered as Liao's vassal, yet I took arms as their ally, offending your Majesty and inviting war.

sentences.zh: 既速違天之咎，果罹敗績之憂。

translations.literal: Having swiftly incurred Heaven's wrath, I indeed suffered the anguish of defeat.
translations.idiomatic: I soon drew Heaven's punishment and suffered crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 蒙降德音以寬前罪，仍賜土地用廣籓籬，載惟含垢之恩，常切戴天之望。

translations.literal: I was favored with a gracious edict to pardon former offenses and was moreover granted lands to broaden the vassal barrier; I bear deeply in mind this grace of swallowing shame and am ever keenly mindful of gratitude bound to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Your gracious edict pardoned my earlier crimes and granted lands to widen my frontier—an indulgence I hold in awe, with gratitude as deep as for life itself.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，凡于歲時朝賀、貢進表章、使人往復等事，一切永依臣事遼國舊例。

translations.literal: From this day forward, in all matters of seasonal court congratulations, tribute and memorials, and envoys coming and going, everything shall forever follow the old precedent of your subject's service to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth seasonal audiences, tribute memorials, and all exchange of envoys shall forever follow the customs of my service to Liao.

sentences.zh: 其契丹昏主今不在臣境，至如奔竄到此，不復存泊，即當執獻。

translations.literal: The benighted Liao Khitan ruler is not now within your subject's borders; should he flee and arrive here, he shall not be harbored but at once be seized and presented.
translations.idiomatic: The deluded Khitan emperor is not within my realm; should he flee here, I will not shelter him but will seize and deliver him at once.

sentences.zh: 若大朝知其所在，以兵追捕，無敢為地及依前援助。

translations.literal: If the Great Court knows where he is and pursues him with troops, I dare not provide territory for refuge or aid him as before.
translations.idiomatic: If the Great Court learns his whereabouts and sends troops in pursuit, I will neither give him refuge nor aid him as I did before.

sentences.zh: 其或徵兵，即當依應。

translations.literal: Should troops be levied, I shall respond accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Should you call upon my forces, I will answer the summons.

sentences.zh: 至如殊方異域朝覲天闕，合經當國道路，亦不阻節。

translations.literal: As for distant regions paying court at the heavenly gate, if they must pass through your subject's territory, passage shall not be impeded.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign realms paying court at the capital, if their route crosses my land, shall pass without hindrance.

sentences.zh: 以上所敘數事，臣誓固此誠，傳嗣不變，苟或有渝，天地鑒察，神明殛之，禍及子孫，不克享國。」

translations.literal: In regard to the several matters set forth above, your subject swears this sincerity firm; it shall be transmitted to heirs without change—if there be any breach, may Heaven and Earth witness, may the spirits strike me down, may disaster reach my descendants, and may I not long enjoy the state."
translations.idiomatic: On all the points above I swear this oath for myself and my heirs; should I break it, may Heaven and Earth bear witness, the spirits destroy me, calamity fall on my descendants, and my line lose the throne."

sentences.zh: 所謂西北，西南兩路都統者宗翰也。

translations.literal: The so-called commanders of the Northwest and Southwest circuits were Zonghan.
translations.idiomatic: The "Southwest and Northwest circuit commanders" referred to here were Zonghan.

sentences.zh: 蓋宗望以太祖命與之通書，而宗翰以便宜割地議和雲。

translations.literal: For Zongwang, by the founding emperor's order, had exchanged letters with them, while Zonghan by discretionary authority ceded land to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang had exchanged letters with Xia under the founding emperor's orders; Zonghan had ceded territory at his own discretion to conclude the peace.

sentences.zh: 太宗使王阿海、楊天吉往賜誓詔曰：「維天會二年歲次甲辰，閏三月戊寅朔，皇帝賜誓詔于夏國王乾順：先皇帝誕膺駿命，肇啟鴻圖，而卿國據夏台，境連遼右，以效力於昏主，致結釁于王師。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong sent Wang Ahai and Yang Tianji to bestow the sworn edict, saying: "In the second year of Tianhui, cyclical year jiachen, the first day of the intercalary third month wuyin, the Emperor bestows this sworn edict on Xia King Qianshun: The former emperor received the glorious mandate and opened the great enterprise, yet your state occupies Xia Terrace, its border joining Liao's western flank, serving the benighted sovereign and thereby provoking enmity with Our armies.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong sent Wang Ahai and Yang Tianji to deliver the sworn edict: "In Tianhui 2, year jiachen, on the first day of the intercalary third month, the Emperor bestows this sworn edict upon Xia King Qianshun: The late emperor received Heaven's mandate and founded our great enterprise, yet your state holds Xia Terrace on Liao's western border, serving a deluded sovereign and thereby drawing Our armies into war.

sentences.zh: 先皇帝以謂忠於所事，務施恩而釋過，迨眇躬之纂紹，仰遺訓以遵行，卿乃深念前非，樂從內附，飭使軺而奉貢，效臣節以稱籓。

translations.literal: The former emperor held that loyalty to one's lord deserves grace and the release of faults; now that this insignificant person has succeeded to the throne, I look up to his testamentary instructions to follow them. You have deeply reflected on past errors, gladly submitted to inner allegiance, ordered envoys in light carriages to present tribute, and shown ministerial devotion in declaring vassalage.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor judged that loyalty to one's sovereign deserved mercy; now that I have succeeded the throne I follow his testament. You have deeply repented your past errors, willingly submitted, sent envoys with tribute, and accepted vassal status with full ministerial devotion.

sentences.zh: 載錫寵光，用彰複好，所有割賜地土、使聘禮節、相為援助等事，一切恭依先朝制詔。

translations.literal: Favor and glory are hereby bestowed to manifest renewed friendship; in all matters of partitioned and granted lands, envoy protocol, and mutual aid, everything shall respectfully follow the former court's established edicts.
translations.idiomatic: We bestow favor to renew our friendship; regarding the granted territories, diplomatic protocol, and mutual aid, all shall follow the regulations of the previous reign.

sentences.zh: 其依應徵兵，所請宜允。

translations.literal: As for responding when troops are levied, your request is approved.
translations.idiomatic: Your request to answer when troops are called upon is granted.

sentences.zh: 三辰在上，朕豈食言，苟或變渝，亦如卿誓。

translations.literal: With sun, moon, and stars above as witness, how could I break my word? If there be any change or breach, it shall be as in your oath.
translations.idiomatic: With Heaven as witness, I shall not break my word; should I fail, may I suffer as you swore for yourself.

sentences.zh: 遠垂戒諭，毋替厥誠。」

translations.literal: From afar I send this admonition and instruction—do not let your sincerity lapse."
translations.idiomatic: From afar I send this charge: do not let your loyalty falter."

sentences.zh: 於是，宋人與夏人俱受山西地，宋人侵取之，乾順遣使表謝賜誓詔、並論宋所侵地。

translations.literal: Thereupon both Song and Xia received Shanxi lands; the Song encroached and seized them. Qianshun sent envoys with a memorial thanking them for the bestowed sworn edict and also addressing the lands the Song had encroached upon.
translations.idiomatic: Song and Xia had both received Shanxi territories, but Song seized portions of Xia's share. Qianshun sent envoys to thank Jin for the sworn edict and to protest Song's encroachments.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「省所上表，具悉，已命西南、西北兩路都統府從宜定奪。」

translations.literal: An edict said: "We have reviewed your submitted memorial and understand it fully; the Southwest and Northwest circuit command headquarters have been ordered to decide as circumstances require."
translations.idiomatic: An edict replied: "We have received your memorial and understand it; the Southwest and Northwest circuit commanders are authorized to settle the matter as they see fit."

sentences.zh: 是時，宗翰朝京師未還，錄夏國奏付權都統斡魯，宋人侵略新受疆土、及使人王阿海爭儀物事，與夏通問以便宜決之。

translations.literal: At this time Zonghan had not yet returned from audience at the capital; the Xia memorial was copied and sent to Acting Commander Wulu, with orders that matters of Song encroachment on newly granted territory and the dispute over protocol gifts with envoy Wang Ahai be settled by exchange with Xia as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan was still at court and had not returned; the Xia memorial was forwarded to Acting Commander Wulu with orders to settle, as circumstances required, both Song's encroachment on newly granted lands and the dispute over ceremonial gifts with envoy Wang Ahai through consultation with Xia.

sentences.zh: 初，以山西九州與宋人，而天德遠在一隅，緩急不可及，割以與夏。

translations.literal: At first the nine prefectures of Shanxi were given to the Song, but Tiande lay far in a corner where urgent needs could not be met in time, so it was ceded to Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the nine Shanxi prefectures were granted to Song, but Tiande lay too remote for timely reinforcement, so that region was ceded to Xia instead.

sentences.zh: 後破宋都獲二帝，乃畫陝西分界，自麟府路洛陽溝東距黃河西岸、西曆暖泉堡，鄜延路米脂穀至累勝寨，環慶路威邊寨過九星原至委布穀口，涇原路威川寨略古蕭關至北谷川，秦鳳路通懷堡至古會州，自此直距黃河，依見今流行分熙河路盡西邊以限封域。

translations.literal: Later, after capturing the Song capital and taking the two emperors, the Shaanxi boundary was drawn: from Luoyang Gully east of the Yellow River's west bank on the Qinfu Circuit, west through Nuanquan Fort; on the Fuyan Circuit from Mizhi Valley to Leisheng Stockade; on the Huanqing Circuit from Weibian Stockade past Jiuxing Plain to Weibu Valley mouth; on the Jingyuan Circuit from Weichuan Stockade past ancient Xia Pass to Beigu Valley; on the Qinfeng Circuit from Tonghuai Fort to ancient Huizhou—thence straight to the Yellow River, and along present practice the entire western border of the Xihe Circuit was divided to delimit the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin captured the Song capital and took the two emperors captive, a Shaanxi boundary was drawn: from Luoyang Gully on the Qinfu Circuit east to the Yellow River's west bank and west through Nuanquan Fort; on the Fuyan Circuit from Mizhi Valley to Leisheng Stockade; on the Huanqing Circuit from Weibian Stockade across Jiuxing Plain to Weibu Valley; on the Jingyuan Circuit from Weichuan Stockade past ancient Xia Pass to Beigu Valley; on the Qinfeng Circuit from Tonghuai Fort to ancient Huizhou—thence due south to the Yellow River, and along current practice the entire western Xihe Circuit was partitioned to fix the frontier.

sentences.zh: 複分陝西北鄙以易天德、雲內，以河為界。

translations.literal: The northwestern corner of Shaanxi was again partitioned, exchanging Tiande and Yunnei, with the river as boundary.
translations.idiomatic: The northwestern Shaanxi marches were then reallocated, trading Tiande and Yunnei with the river as the boundary.

sentences.zh: 及婁室定陝西，婆盧火率兵先取威戎城。

translations.literal: When Loushi pacified Shaanxi, Poluhuo led troops first to take Weirong City.
translations.idiomatic: When Loushi secured Shaanxi, Poluhuo led the vanguard to capture Weirong.

sentences.zh: 軍至威戎東與敵遇，擊走之，生致二人，問之，乃知為夏將李遇取威戎也，乃還其人而與李遇通問。

translations.literal: The army reached east of Weirong and met the enemy, routed them, and took two men alive; on questioning them they learned that Xia general Li Yu had taken Weirong, so they returned the captives and sent messages to Li Yu.
translations.idiomatic: East of Weirong they met the enemy, drove them off, and took two prisoners alive. Questioning revealed that Xia general Li Yu had seized Weirong, so they released the captives and opened correspondence with Li Yu.

sentences.zh: 李遇軍威戎西，蒲察軍威戎東，而使使議事于婁室。

translations.literal: Li Yu's army was west of Weirong and Pucha's army east of Weirong, and envoys were sent to discuss the matter with Loushi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu held Weirong from the west and Pucha from the east, and envoys were dispatched to consult Loushi.

sentences.zh: 婁室報曰：「元帥府約束，若兵近夏境，則與夏人相為掎角，毋相侵犯。」

translations.literal: Loushi replied: "The marshal's headquarters has ordered that when troops approach the Xia border, Jin and Xia shall act as pincers and not encroach on one another."
translations.idiomatic: Loushi replied: "Marshal headquarters has ruled that when our forces approach the Xia border, we and the Xia shall coordinate as allies and not attack each other."

sentences.zh: 李遇使人來曰：「夏國既以天德、雲內歸大國，大國許我陝西北鄙之地，是以至此。」

translations.literal: Li Yu sent a messenger saying: "Since the Xia state has returned Tiande and Yunnei to the Great State, and the Great State granted us the northwestern marches of Shaanxi, we have come here for that reason."
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu's envoy said: "Xia has surrendered Tiande and Yunnei to the Great State, and the Great State granted us the northwestern Shaanxi marches—that is why we are here."

sentences.zh: 蒲察等遂旋軍。

translations.literal: Pucha and the others thereupon withdrew their armies.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha and his forces then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 睿宗既定陝西，元帥府不欲以陝西北鄙與夏國，詔曰：「卿等審處所宜從事。」

translations.literal: After Emperor Ruizong had pacified Shaanxi, the marshal's headquarters did not wish to give the northwestern marches of Shaanxi to the Xia state; an edict said: "You are to weigh what is appropriate and act accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: Once Emperor Ruizong had secured Shaanxi, marshal headquarters was reluctant to cede the northwestern marches to Xia; an edict instructed the commanders to decide what course was appropriate.

sentences.zh: 天眷二年，國王乾順薨，子仁孝立，遣使冊命，加開府儀同三司上柱國。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianjuan the king Qianshun died; his son Renxiao succeeded; envoys were sent to invest him, and he was promoted to Grand Preceptor of the State with the rank of Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Supreme Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjuan 2 King Qianshun died and his son Renxiao succeeded. Jin sent envoys to invest him, conferring Grand Preceptor of the State with the rank of Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Supreme Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 皇統元年，請置榷場、許之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangtong they requested establishment of a frontier market; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangtong 1 they requested a frontier trading post, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 初，王阿海等乙太宗誓詔賜夏國，乾順以契丹舊儀見使者，阿海不肯曰：「契丹與夏國甥舅也，故國王坐受，使者以禮進。

translations.literal: At first, when Wang Ahai and others carried Emperor Taizong's sworn edict to bestow on the Xia state, Qianshun received the envoys by the old Khitan protocol, seated; Ahai refused, saying: "Khitan and Xia were uncle and nephew by marriage, so the king could sit and receive while the envoy advanced with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Ahai first delivered Emperor Taizong's sworn edict to Xia, Qianshun received the envoys by the old Khitan protocol, remaining seated. Ahai objected: "Under the Khitan, Xia was Liao's nephew by marriage, so your king could sit while the envoy performed the rites.

sentences.zh: 今大金與夏國君臣也，見大國使者當如儀。」

translations.literal: Now Great Jin and the Xia state are sovereign and subject; in receiving envoys of the Great State you must follow the proper rites."
translations.idiomatic: Great Jin and Xia are now sovereign and subject; in receiving envoys of the Great State you must observe the proper ceremony."

sentences.zh: 爭數日不能決，於是始起立受焉。

translations.literal: They disputed for several days without resolution, and only then did Qianshun first rise to receive standing.
translations.idiomatic: The dispute lasted several days before Qianshun finally rose to receive the edict standing.

sentences.zh: 厥後不遣賜生日使，至是始遣使賜之。

translations.literal: Afterward birthday-congratulation envoys had not been sent; only now were envoys first dispatched with gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Jin had not previously sent birthday-congratulation envoys; only now were they first dispatched.

sentences.zh: 初，慕洧以環州降，及割陝西、河南與宋人，洧奔夏國，夏人以為山訛首領。

translations.literal: At first Mu Wei surrendered Huan Prefecture; when Shaanxi and Henan were ceded to the Song, Wei fled to the Xia state, and the Xia made him a Shan'e chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Wei had first surrendered Huan Prefecture to Jin; when Shaanxi and Henan were ceded to Song he fled to Xia, which appointed him a Shan'e chieftain.

sentences.zh: 及撒離喝再定陝西，洧思歸，夏人知之，遂族洧，以表聞，詔書責讓之。

translations.literal: When Salihua again pacified Shaanxi, Wei wished to return; the Xia learned of it and thereupon exterminated Wei's clan, reporting by memorial; an edict rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: When Salihua reconquered Shaanxi, Wei sought to return to Jin. Xia discovered his intent, executed his entire clan, and reported the matter; Jin issued a rebuking edict.

sentences.zh: 及海陵弑熙宗，遣使報諭至境上，夏人問曰：「聖德皇帝何為見廢。」

translations.literal: When Hailing murdered Emperor Xizong and sent envoys with notification to the border, the Xia asked: "Why was the Sagely Virtue Emperor deposed?"
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing murdered Emperor Xizong and sent envoys to announce the change at the border, the Xia asked: "Why was the Sagely Virtue Emperor deposed?"

sentences.zh: 不肯納。

translations.literal: They refused to receive the envoys.
translations.idiomatic: They refused to admit the envoys.

sentences.zh: 朝廷乃使有司以廢立之故移文報之。

translations.literal: The court then had the responsible offices send a written communication explaining the reasons for deposition and enthronement.
translations.idiomatic: The court then had the appropriate offices send a formal dispatch explaining the deposition and succession.

sentences.zh: 天德二年七月，夏使御史中丞雜辣公濟等來賀，如舊禮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Tiande, Xia envoys including Censor-in-Chief Zala Gongji came to offer congratulations, following the old protocol.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Tiande 2, Xia envoys led by Censor-in-Chief Zala Gongji came to offer congratulations according to the established rites.

sentences.zh: 久之，其臣任得敬專國政，欲分割夏國。

translations.literal: After a long time his minister Ren Dedejing monopolized state power and wished to partition the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: In time his minister Ren Dedejing seized control of government and sought to carve up the Xia state.

sentences.zh: 因賀大定八年正旦，遣奏告使殿前太尉芭裏昌祖等以仁孝章乞良醫為得敬治疾，詔保全郎王師道佩銀牌往焉。

translations.literal: On the occasion of congratulating the New Year of the eighth year of Dading, he sent memorial envoys including Palace Commander Balichangzu with a memorial from Renxiao requesting a skilled physician to treat Dedejing's illness; an edict ordered Preservation Officer Wang Shidao, bearing a silver tablet, to go.
translations.idiomatic: When congratulating the New Year of Dading 8, Xia sent memorial envoys led by Palace Commander Balichangzu with a petition from Renxiao requesting a skilled physician for Dedejing's illness. An edict ordered Preservation Officer Wang Shidao, bearing a silver tablet, to proceed.

sentences.zh: 詔師道曰：「如病勢不可療，則勿治。

translations.literal: The edict told Shidao: "If the illness cannot be treated, then do not treat it.
translations.idiomatic: The edict instructed Shidao: "If the illness is beyond cure, do not treat it.

sentences.zh: 如可治，期一月歸。」

translations.literal: If it can be treated, return within one month."
translations.idiomatic: If it can be treated, return within one month."

sentences.zh: 得敬疾有瘳，遣謝恩使任得聰來，得敬亦附表進禮物，上曰：「得敬自有定分，附表禮物皆不可受。」

translations.literal: When Dedejing's illness improved somewhat, he sent a gratitude envoy Ren Decong, and Dedejing also attached a memorial presenting gifts. The emperor said: "Dedejing has his allotted fate; the attached memorial and gifts must none of them be accepted."
translations.idiomatic: When Dedejing recovered somewhat, he sent gratitude envoy Ren Decong, and Dedejing also attached a memorial with gifts. The emperor said: "Dedejing has his allotted fate; neither the memorial nor the gifts may be accepted."

sentences.zh: 並卻之。

translations.literal: All were refused.
translations.idiomatic: All were declined.

sentences.zh: 初，仁孝嗣位，其臣屢作亂，任得敬抗禦有功，遂相夏二十餘年，陰蓄異志，欲圖夏國，誣殺宗親大臣，其勢漸逼，仁孝不能制。

translations.literal: At first, when Renxiao succeeded to the throne, his ministers repeatedly rebelled; Ren Dedejing had merit in resisting them and served as chief minister of Xia for more than twenty years, secretly harboring divergent aims and plotting against the Xia state, falsely executing imperial clansmen and great ministers; his power gradually pressed close and Renxiao could not control him.
translations.idiomatic: When Renxiao first succeeded, his ministers rebelled repeatedly; Ren Dedejing distinguished himself in suppressing them and served as chief minister for more than twenty years. He secretly harbored ambitions against the state, executed imperial kinsmen and high officials on false charges, and grew so powerful that Renxiao could no longer restrain him.

sentences.zh: 大定十年，乃分西南路及靈州羅龐嶺地與得敬，自為國，且上表為得敬求封。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Dading he partitioned off the Southwest Circuit and the Luopang Ridge lands of Ling Prefecture for Dedejing, who set himself up as a separate state, and moreover submitted a memorial requesting enfeoffment for Dedejing.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 10 he carved off the Southwest Circuit and the Luopang Ridge region of Ling Prefecture for Dedejing, who proclaimed himself a separate ruler, and submitted a memorial asking Jin to enfeoff him.

sentences.zh: 世宗以問宰相，尚書令李石等曰：「事系彼國，我何預焉，不如因而許之。」

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong asked the chief ministers; Grand Secretary Li Shi and others said: "This concerns their state—what have we to do with it? Better to grant it accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong consulted his chief ministers. Grand Secretary Li Shi and others said: "This is their internal affair—why should we interfere? Better to grant the request."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「有國之主豈肯無故分國與人，此必權臣逼奪，非夏王本意。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Would the sovereign of a state willingly partition his realm for no reason and give it to another? This must be a powerful minister forcing seizure—it is not the Xia king's true intent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Would any sovereign willingly cede his realm without cause? This must be a powerful minister seizing power by force—not the Xia king's true will.

sentences.zh: 況夏國稱籓歲久，一旦迫於賊臣，朕為四海主，甯容此邪？

translations.literal: Moreover, the Xia state has been a vassal for many years; suddenly pressed by a treacherous minister—how could I, lord of all within the four seas, tolerate this?
translations.idiomatic: Xia has been our vassal for many years; shall I, sovereign of all under Heaven, stand by while a traitorous minister forces its partition?

sentences.zh: 若彼不能自正，則當以兵誅之，不可許也。」

translations.literal: If they cannot set themselves right, then troops should be sent to punish him—it cannot be granted."
translations.idiomatic: If they cannot correct this themselves, we shall send troops to punish the traitor—the request cannot be granted."

sentences.zh: 乃卻其貢物，賜仁孝詔曰：「自我國家戡定中原，懷柔西土，始則畫疆于乃父，繼而錫命於爾躬，恩厚一方，年垂三紀，籓臣之禮既務踐修，先業所傳亦當固守。

translations.literal: Their tribute gifts were refused, and an edict was bestowed on Renxiao saying: "Since Our state pacified the Central Plain and embraced the western lands, first borders were drawn for your father, then commands were bestowed on your person; grace has been deep in your region for nearly three decades; vassal rites have been diligently practiced, and the patrimony handed down should also be firmly held.
translations.idiomatic: Their tribute was refused, and an edict was sent to Renxiao: "Since Our dynasty pacified the Central Plain and embraced the western lands, we first drew your father's borders, then invested you personally. For nearly three decades we have shown you deep favor; you have diligently observed vassal rites, and the patrimony you inherited must be firmly upheld.

sentences.zh: 今茲請命，事頗靡常，未知措意之由來，續當遣使以詢爾。

translations.literal: This present request is quite irregular; we do not know the source of your intent, and shall later send envoys to inquire of you.
translations.idiomatic: This present request is most irregular; we do not know what prompted it, and shall send envoys to inquire of you.

sentences.zh: 所有貢物，已令發回。」

translations.literal: All tribute goods have been ordered sent back."
translations.idiomatic: All tribute goods have been ordered returned."

sentences.zh: 得敬密通宋人求助，宋以蠟丸書答得敬，夏人得之。

translations.literal: Dedejing secretly communicated with the Song to seek aid; Song replied to Dedejing with a letter in a wax pellet, which the Xia obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Dedejing secretly appealed to Song for help; Song replied in a wax-sealed message, which Xia intercepted.

sentences.zh: 得敬始因求醫附表進禮物，欲以嘗試世宗，既不可行，而求封又不可得，仁孝乃謀誅之。

translations.literal: Dedejing had first, under the pretext of seeking a physician, attached a memorial presenting gifts to test Emperor Shizong; when that could not succeed and enfeoffment also could not be obtained, Renxiao then plotted to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: Dedejing had first used the medical mission to present gifts and test Emperor Shizong's intentions; when that failed and enfeoffment was denied, Renxiao plotted his execution.

sentences.zh: 八月晦，仁孝誅得敬及其黨與，上表謝，並以所執宋人及蠟丸書來上。

translations.literal: On the last day of the eighth month Renxiao executed Dedejing and his faction, submitted a memorial of thanks, and also sent up the Song men they had seized and the wax-pellet letter.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the eighth month Renxiao executed Dedejing and his followers, submitted a memorial of thanks, and forwarded the captured Song agents and the wax-sealed letter.

sentences.zh: 其謝表曰：「得敬初受分土之後，曾遣使赴大朝代求封建，蒙詔書不為俞納，此朝廷憐愛之恩，夏國不勝感戴。

translations.literal: The memorial of thanks said: "After Dedejing first received his partitioned lands, he once sent envoys to the Great Court to request enfeoffment; we received an edict refusing approval—this was the court's compassionate grace, which the Xia state cannot sufficiently requite in gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial of thanks read: "After Dedejing received his partitioned lands he once sent envoys to the Great Court requesting enfeoffment; your edict refused approval—this was the court's compassionate grace, for which Xia is profoundly grateful.

sentences.zh: 夏國妄煩朝廷，冒求賊臣封建，深虧禮節。

translations.literal: The Xia state presumptuously troubled the court, daring to seek enfeoffment for a treacherous minister—deeply violating propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Xia presumptuously troubled the court by seeking enfeoffment for a traitor—a grave breach of propriety.

sentences.zh: 今既賊臣誅訖，大朝不用遣使詢問。

translations.literal: Now that the treacherous minister has been executed, the Great Court need not send envoys to inquire.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the traitor has been executed, the Great Court need not send envoys to inquire.

sentences.zh: 得敬所分之地與大朝熙秦路接境，恐自分地以來別有生事，已根勘禁約，乞朝廷亦行禁約。」

translations.literal: The lands Dedejing partitioned border the Great Court's Xi-Qin Circuit; fearing that since the partition other incidents may arise, we have thoroughly investigated and imposed prohibitions—we beg the court also to impose prohibitions."
translations.idiomatic: Dedejing's partitioned lands border Jin's Xi-Qin Circuit; fearing further incidents since the partition, we have investigated and imposed restrictions—we beg the court to impose matching restrictions as well."

sentences.zh: 十二年，上謂宰臣曰：「夏國以珠玉易我絲帛，是以無用易我有用也。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the emperor told the chief ministers: "The Xia state exchanges pearls and jade for our silk and cloth—they trade what is useless for what is useful to us."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the emperor told his ministers: "Xia trades pearls and jade for our silk and cloth—they exchange what is useless to them for what is useful to us."

sentences.zh: 乃減罷保安、蘭州榷場。

translations.literal: Thereupon the frontier markets at Bao'an and Lanzhou were reduced and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier markets at Bao'an and Lanzhou were then scaled back and closed.

sentences.zh: 仁孝深念世宗恩厚，十七年，獻本國所造百頭帳，上曰：「夏國貢獻自有方物，可卻之。」

translations.literal: Renxiao deeply remembered Emperor Shizong's generous grace; in the seventeenth year he presented a hundred-headed tent made in his state. The emperor said: "The Xia state's tribute has its established goods; this may be refused."
translations.idiomatic: Renxiao deeply appreciated Emperor Shizong's generosity; in the seventeenth year he presented a hundred-headed tent of Xia manufacture. The emperor said: "Xia's tribute has its established categories; this may be declined."

sentences.zh: 仁孝再以表上曰：「所進帳本非珍異，使人亦已到邊，若不蒙包納，則下國深誠無所展效，四方鄰國以為夏國不預大朝眷愛之數，將何所安。」

translations.literal: Renxiao again submitted a memorial saying: "The tent presented is not in itself rare or exotic, and the envoys have already reached the border; if it is not accepted, our lesser state has no way to show its deep sincerity, and neighboring states on all sides will think the Xia state is not among those the Great Court favors—how could we be at ease?"
translations.idiomatic: Renxiao submitted another memorial: "The tent presented is not especially rare, and our envoys have already reached the border. If it is not accepted, our lesser state has no way to express its sincerity, and neighboring states will think Xia no longer enjoys the Great Court's favor—how could we bear that?"

sentences.zh: 乃許與正旦使同來。

translations.literal: Permission was then granted for it to come together with the New Year envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Permission was then granted for it to arrive with the New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 明昌四年，仁孝薨，子純佑嗣立。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Mingchang Renxiao died; his son Chunyou succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 4 Renxiao died and his son Chunyou succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，複置蘭州、保安榷場。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an the Lanzhou and Bao'an frontier markets were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In Cheng'an 2 the Lanzhou and Bao'an frontier markets were re-established.

sentences.zh: 承安五年，純佑母病風求醫，詔太醫判官時德元及王利貞往，仍賜禦藥。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Cheng'an Chunyou's mother suffered wind illness and sought a physician; an edict ordered Senior Imperial Physicians Shideyuan and Wang Lizhen to go, and imperial medicine was also bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In Cheng'an 5 Chunyou's mother suffered a stroke and sought medical aid; an edict dispatched Senior Imperial Physicians Shideyuan and Wang Lizhen, along with imperial medicine.

sentences.zh: 八月，再賜醫藥。

translations.literal: In the eighth month medicine was again bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month medicine was sent again.

sentences.zh: 泰和六年三月，仁孝弟仁友子安全，廢純佑自立，再閱月死於廢所。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year of Taihe, Renxiao's younger brother Renyou's son Anquan deposed Chunyou and installed himself; one month later Chunyou died in the place of his deposition.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Taihe 6, Renxiao's nephew Anquan, son of Renyou, deposed Chunyou and seized the throne; one month later Chunyou died in confinement.

sentences.zh: 七月，使純佑母羅氏為表，言純佑不能嗣守，與大臣定議立安全為王，遣使奏告。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Chunyou's mother Lady Luo was made to submit a memorial stating that Chunyou could not succeed and hold the throne, that she and the great ministers had decided to install Anquan as king, and envoys were sent to report.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Chunyou's mother Lady Luo submitted a memorial stating that Chunyou could not maintain the throne, that she and the chief ministers had agreed to install Anquan as king, and envoys were dispatched to report the change.

sentences.zh: 夏使私問館伴官：「奏告事詔許否？」

translations.literal: The Xia envoy privately asked the escort officer: "Has the memorial report been approved by edict?"
translations.idiomatic: The Xia envoy privately asked the escort officer: "Has the memorial report been approved?"

sentences.zh: 館伴官曰：「此不當問也。」

translations.literal: The escort officer said: "That is not something you should ask."
translations.idiomatic: The escort officer replied: "That is not for you to ask."

sentences.zh: 夏使曰：「明日當問諸客省，若又不答，則升殿奏請。」

translations.literal: The Xia envoy said: "Tomorrow I shall ask the Reception Office; if they again do not answer, I shall ascend the hall and petition."
translations.idiomatic: The Xia envoy said: "Tomorrow I shall ask the Reception Office; if they refuse again, I shall petition before the throne."

sentences.zh: 上聞之，使客省諭以許所祈之意，乃賜羅氏詔詢其意，夏人複以羅氏表來，乃封安全為夏國王。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it, he had the Reception Office inform them that their request was granted, then bestowed an edict on Lady Luo inquiring of her intent; the Xia again sent Lady Luo's memorial, and Anquan was enfeoffed as King of Xia.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of this, he had the Reception Office inform them that their request was granted, then sent an edict to Lady Luo inquiring of her intent. When Xia submitted Lady Luo's memorial again, Anquan was enfeoffed as King of Xia.

sentences.zh: 崇慶元年三月，攻葭州。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Chongqing they attacked Jia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Chongqing 1 they attacked Jia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至甯元年六月，攻保安州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Zhiyong they attacked Bao'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Zhiyong 1 they attacked Bao'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 貞祐元年十一月，攻會州，都統徒單醜兒擊走之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Zhenyou they attacked Huizhou; Commander Tudan Chou'er routed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Zhenyou 1 they attacked Huizhou; Commander Tudan Chou'er drove them off.

sentences.zh: 十二月，陷涇州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they captured Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month they captured Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，歸國人喬成齎夏國書，大概言金邊吏侵略，乞禁戢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year the returned subject Qiao Cheng carried a letter from the Xia state, stating in general that Jin border officials were encroaching and begging that they be restrained.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year the repatriated subject Qiao Cheng delivered a Xia letter complaining that Jin border officials were encroaching and begging that they be restrained.

sentences.zh: 詔移文答之，宰臣言：「既非公牒，今將責問，彼必飾詞，徒為虛文，無益於事。」

translations.literal: An edict ordered a written reply; the chief ministers said: "Since it is not an official dispatch, if we now hold them accountable they will certainly dress up their words—it would be empty formality without benefit to the matter."
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a written reply; the chief ministers said: "Since this is not an official dispatch, if we press them for answers they will only dress up their excuses—empty formalities that accomplish nothing."

sentences.zh: 乃止。

translations.literal: The matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was then dropped.

sentences.zh: 未幾，夏人攻慶原、延安、積石州，乃詔有司移文責問。

translations.literal: Before long the Xia attacked Qingyuan, Yan'an, and Jishi Prefecture, and an edict ordered the responsible offices to send written rebukes.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Xia forces attacked Qingyuan, Yan'an, and Jishi Prefecture, and the court ordered a formal written rebuke.

sentences.zh: 十一月，蘭州譯人程陳僧結夏人以州叛，邊將敗其兵三千。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Lanzhou interpreter Cheng Chenseng joined with Xia men to rebel with the prefecture; border generals defeated three thousand of their troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Lanzhou interpreter Cheng Chenseng colluded with Xia forces to rebel with the prefecture; border generals defeated three thousand of their troops.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，夏兵攻武延川，宣宗曰：「此不足慮，恐由他道入也。」

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Xia troops attacked Wuyanchuan; Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is not worth worrying about—fear that they may enter by another route."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year Xia troops attacked Wuyanchuan. Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is no great concern—they may be entering by another route."

sentences.zh: 既而聞邊吏侵夏境，夏人乃攻環州，詔治邊吏罪。

translations.literal: Soon afterward it was learned that border officials had encroached on Xia territory; the Xia then attacked Huan Prefecture, and an edict ordered punishment of the border officials.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward it was learned that Jin border officials had encroached on Xia territory; Xia then attacked Huan Prefecture, and an edict ordered the border officials punished.

sentences.zh: 夏兵攻積石州，都統姜伯通敗之。

translations.literal: Xia troops attacked Jishi Prefecture; Commander Jiang Botong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Xia troops attacked Jishi Prefecture; Commander Jiang Botong defeated them.

sentences.zh: 夏兵入安鄉關，都統曹記僧、萬戶忽三十卻之。

translations.literal: Xia troops entered Anxiang Pass; Commanders Cao Jiseng and the ten-thousand-household officer Hu Sanshi repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: Xia troops entered Anxiang Pass; Commanders Cao Jiseng and the ten-thousand-household officer Hu Sanshi drove them back.

sentences.zh: 二月，攻環州，刺史烏古論延壽敗之於境上。

translations.literal: In the second month they attacked Huan Prefecture; Prefect Wugulun Yanshou defeated them on the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month they attacked Huan Prefecture; Prefect Wugulun Yanshou defeated them at the frontier.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔議伐夏，陝西宣撫司奏：「往者，夏人侵我環、慶，河、蘭、積石以兵應之，悉皆遁去，遽還巢穴，蓋為我備也。

translations.literal: In the third month an edict ordered discussion of campaigning against Xia; the Shaanxi Pacification Commission memorialized: "In the past, when Xia men invaded our Huan and Qing circuits, He, Lan, and Jishi responded with troops and they all fled, swiftly returning to their lairs—this was because they were on guard against us.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the court debated a campaign against Xia. The Shaanxi Pacification Commission reported: "When Xia invaded our Huan and Qing circuits in the past, He, Lan, and Jishi responded with troops and the enemy fled straight back to their lairs—they were on guard against us.

sentences.zh: 今蘭州潰兵猶未集，軍實多不完，沿邊地寒，春草始生，未可芻牧，兩界無煙火者三百餘裏，不宜輕舉。」

translations.literal: Now Lanzhou's scattered troops have not yet been gathered, military stores are largely incomplete, the borderlands are cold, spring grass has only begun to grow and cannot yet be cut for fodder, and for more than three hundred li on both sides there is no sign of habitation—it is not fitting to act rashly."
translations.idiomatic: Lanzhou's scattered troops have not yet reassembled, supplies are incomplete, the frontier is still cold, spring grass has only just sprouted and cannot yet feed herds, and for more than three hundred li along both borders there is no habitation—a rash campaign is inadvisable."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The memorial was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court accepted this advice.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔河州提控曹記僧、通遠軍節度使完顏狗兒討程陳僧，夏人援之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month an edict ordered Hezhou Controller Cao Jiseng and Tongyuan Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Gou'er to suppress Cheng Chenseng; the Xia came to his aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict ordered Hezhou Controller Cao Jiseng and Tongyuan Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Gou'er to suppress Cheng Chenseng; Xia forces came to his aid.

sentences.zh: 九月，遂破西關堡。

translations.literal: In the ninth month they then captured Xiguan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month they captured Xiguan Fort.

sentences.zh: 夏人複攻第五將城，萬戶楊再興擊走之。

translations.literal: The Xia again attacked the Fifth Commandery city; the ten-thousand-household officer Yang Zaixing drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Xia forces again attacked the Fifth Commandery city; the ten-thousand-household officer Yang Zaixing drove them off.

sentences.zh: 詔陝西宣撫司及沿邊諸將，降空名宣敕，臨陣立功，五品以下並聽遷授。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Shaanxi Pacification Commission and border generals to issue blank-name edicts of appointment: those who achieved merit in battle, fifth rank and below, were all permitted promotion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict authorized the Shaanxi Pacification Commission and border generals to issue blank appointment edicts: officers of fifth rank and below who distinguished themselves in battle could be promoted on the spot.

sentences.zh: 十月，攻保安及延安，都統完顏國家奴破之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month they attacked Bao'an and Yan'an; Commander Wanyan Guojianu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they attacked Bao'an and Yan'an; Commander Wanyan Guojianu defeated them.

sentences.zh: 既而深入臨洮，總管陀滿胡土門不能禦，陝西宣撫副使完顏胡失來救臨洮，大敗於渭源堡，城破，胡失來被執。

translations.literal: They then penetrated deep into Lintao; Commander Tuoman Hutumen could not withstand them. Shaanxi Pacification Vice Commissioner Wanyan Hushilai came to rescue Lintao but suffered a great defeat at Weiyuan Fort; the city fell and Hushilai was captured.
translations.idiomatic: They then pushed deep into Lintao; Commander Tuoman Hutumen could not hold them. Shaanxi Pacification Vice Commissioner Wanyan Hushilai marched to relieve Lintao but was routed at Weiyuan Fort; the city fell and Hushilai was captured.

sentences.zh: 十一月，夏兵敗於克戎寨，複敗於熟羊寨，宰相入賀，宣宗曰：「此忠賢之力也。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Xia troops were defeated at Kerong Stockade and again at Shuyang Stockade; the chief ministers entered to offer congratulations, and Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is the power of loyal worthies."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Xia troops were defeated at Kerong Stockade and again at Shuyang Stockade. The chief ministers came to congratulate him, and Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is the work of loyal servants."

sentences.zh: 夏兵進圍臨洮，陀滿胡土門破之。

translations.literal: Xia troops advanced to besiege Lintao; Tuoman Hutumen defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Xia troops advanced to besiege Lintao; Tuoman Hutumen defeated them.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，夏葩俄族總管汪三郎率眾來降，進羊千口，詔納之，優給其直。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year Xia Pa'e tribe Commander Wang Sanlang led his followers to surrender, presenting a thousand sheep; an edict accepted them and generously paid their value.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year Xia Pa'e tribe Commander Wang Sanlang surrendered with his followers, presenting a thousand sheep; the court accepted them and paid generously.

sentences.zh: 來遠鎮獲諜人，言宋、夏相結來攻，詔陝西行省備之。

translations.literal: Laiyuan Town captured a spy who said Song and Xia had joined to attack; an edict ordered the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: Laiyuan Town captured a spy reporting that Song and Xia had allied to attack; an edict ordered the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat to prepare defenses.

sentences.zh: 夏於來羌城界河起折橋，元帥右都監完顏賽不焚之，斬馘甚眾。

translations.literal: The Xia built a pontoon bridge across the border river at Laicheng; Marshal Right Controller Wanyan Saibu burned it and killed many.
translations.idiomatic: Xia built a pontoon bridge across the border river at Laicheng; Marshal Right Controller Wanyan Saibu burned it and killed many of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 六月，鄜延路奏，夏人牒報用彼國光定年號，詔封還其牒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Fuyan Circuit reported that Xia dispatches used their state's Guangding reign title; an edict ordered the dispatches sealed and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Fuyan Circuit reported that Xia dispatches used their Guangding reign title; an edict ordered the dispatches sealed and returned unopened.

sentences.zh: 閏月，慶陽總管慶山奴伐夏，出環州，陝西行省請中分其軍，令慶山奴出第三將懷安寨，環州刺史完顏胡魯出環州，宣宗曰：「聞夏人移軍備其王城，尚恐詐我，勿墮其計中也。」

translations.literal: In the intercalary month Qingyang Commander Qingshannu campaigned against Xia, setting out from Huan Prefecture; the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat requested dividing his army, ordering Qingshannu out from the Third Commandery's Huaian Stockade and Huan Prefect Wanyan Hulu out from Huan Prefecture. Emperor Xuanzong said: "I hear the Xia have shifted troops to guard their royal city—still fear they may be deceiving us; do not fall into their trap."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Qingyang Commander Qingshannu campaigned against Xia from Huan Prefecture. The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat proposed splitting his army, with Qingshannu advancing from Huaian Stockade of the Third Commandery and Huan Prefect Wanyan Hulu from Huan Prefecture. Emperor Xuanzong said: "I hear Xia has shifted troops to guard their capital—they may still be trying to deceive us; do not fall into their trap."

sentences.zh: 提控完顏狗兒抵蘭州西關堡，招得舊部曲九人。

translations.literal: Controller Wanyan Gou'er reached Lanzhou's Xiguan Fort and recruited nine of his former retainers.
translations.idiomatic: Controller Wanyan Gou'er reached Lanzhou's Xiguan Fort and recruited nine of his former retainers.

sentences.zh: 掩擊夏兵于阿彌灣，殺其將士百餘人。

translations.literal: He made a surprise attack on Xia troops at Ami Bay and killed more than a hundred officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: He ambushed Xia troops at Ami Bay and killed more than a hundred officers and men.

sentences.zh: 八月，左監軍烏古論慶壽敗夏兵于安塞堡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Left Controller Wugulun Qingshou defeated Xia troops at Ansa Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Left Controller Wugulun Qingshou defeated Xia troops at Ansa Fort.

sentences.zh: 右都監賽不擊走夏兵於結耶觜川，複破之于車兒堡。

translations.literal: Right Controller Saibu drove off Xia troops at Jieyezui Stream and again defeated them at Che'er Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Right Controller Saibu drove off Xia troops at Jieyezui Stream and defeated them again at Che'er Fort.

sentences.zh: 十一月，提控石盞合喜、楊斡烈解定西之圍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Controllers Shizhan Hexi and Yang Wolie lifted the siege of Dingxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Controllers Shizhan Hexi and Yang Wolie lifted the siege of Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，宣宗與皇太子議伐夏，左監軍陀滿胡土門、延安總管古裏甲石倫攻鹽、宥、夏州，慶陽總管慶山奴、知平涼府移剌答不也攻威、靈、安、會等州。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the twelfth month Emperor Xuanzong and the crown prince discussed campaigning against Xia: Left Controller Tuoman Hutumen and Yan'an Commander Gulijia Shilun were to attack Yan, You, and Xia Prefectures; Qingyang Commander Qingshannu and Pingliang Prefect Yila Dabuye were to attack Wei, Ling, An, and Hui Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the twelfth month Emperor Xuanzong and the crown prince planned a campaign against Xia: Left Controller Tuoman Hutumen and Yan'an Commander Gulijia Shilun would attack Yan, You, and Xia Prefectures; Qingyang Commander Qingshannu and Pingliang Prefect Yila Dabuye would attack Wei, Ling, An, and Hui Prefectures.

sentences.zh: 興定元年正月，夏兵三萬自寧州還，慶山奴以兵邀擊，敗之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Xingding thirty thousand Xia troops were returning from Ning Prefecture; Qingshannu intercepted them with troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Xingding 1 thirty thousand Xia troops were returning from Ning Prefecture; Qingshannu intercepted and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 詔河東行省胥鼎選兵三萬五千，付陀滿胡土門伐夏，鼎馳奏不可，遂止，語在鼎傳。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Hedong Branch Secretariat Xud Ding to select thirty-five thousand troops and hand them to Tuoman Hutumen to campaign against Xia; Ding urgently memorialized that it could not be done, and the matter was stopped—the account is in Ding's biography.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Hedong Branch Secretariat Xud Ding to select thirty-five thousand troops for Tuoman Hutumen's Xia campaign; Ding urgently memorialized against it and the plan was halted, as recorded in his biography.

sentences.zh: 右都監完顏仲元請試兵西夏，出其不意必獲全勝，兵威既振，國力益完。

translations.literal: Right Controller Wanyan Zhongyuan requested trial of troops against Western Xia, saying that striking by surprise would surely win complete victory, military prestige would be aroused, and national strength further perfected.
translations.idiomatic: Right Controller Wanyan Zhongyuan proposed testing Jin's forces against Western Xia, arguing that a surprise strike would win a complete victory, restore military prestige, and strengthen the state.

sentences.zh: 詔下尚書省、樞密院議。

translations.literal: An edict referred the matter to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict referred the proposal to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 夏人福山以俘戶來降，除同知澤州軍州事。

translations.literal: The Xia man Fushan came over with captive households and was appointed Associate Administrator of Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia subject Fushan surrendered with captive households and was appointed Associate Administrator of Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月，夏兵入大北岔，都統紇石烈豬狗掩擊，敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Xia troops entered Dabeicha; Commander Geshilie Zhugou made a surprise attack and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Xia troops entered Dabeicha; Commander Geshilie Zhugou ambushed and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 宣宗欲與夏議和，右都監慶山奴屯延安，奏曰：「夏國決不肯和，徒見欺耳。」

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong wished to negotiate peace with Xia; Right Controller Qingshannu, stationed at Yan'an, memorialized: "The Xia state will certainly not agree to peace—we would only be deceived."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong wished to negotiate peace with Xia. Right Controller Qingshannu, stationed at Yan'an, memorialized: "Xia will never agree to peace—we would only be deceived."

sentences.zh: 既而，獲諜者言，遵頊聞大金將約和，戒諭將士無犯西鄙。

translations.literal: Soon afterward a captured spy said that Zunxian, hearing that Great Jin was about to make peace, had admonished his officers and men not to violate the western border.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward a captured spy reported that Zunxian, hearing Jin was about to negotiate peace, had ordered his troops not to violate the western border.

sentences.zh: 宰臣奏曰：「就令如此，邊備亦不宜弛。」

translations.literal: The chief ministers memorialized: "Even if this is so, border defenses should not be relaxed."
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers memorialized: "Even if this is true, border defenses must not be relaxed."

sentences.zh: 宣宗以為然。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong agreed.

sentences.zh: 右都監完顏閭山敗夏兵于黃鶴岔。

translations.literal: Right Controller Wanyan Lüshan defeated Xia troops at Huanghe Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Right Controller Wanyan Lüshan defeated Xia troops at Huanghe Pass.

sentences.zh: 夏人圍羊狠寨，都統黨世昌與戰，完顏狗兒遣都統夾穀瑞夜斫夏營，遂解其圍，猶駐近地，左都監白撒發定西銳兵、龕谷副統包孝成緋翮翅軍，合擊走之。

translations.literal: Xia men besieged Yanghen Stockade; Commander Dang Shichang fought them. Wanyan Gou'er sent Commander Jiagu Rui to strike the Xia camp by night, lifting the siege, but they still camped nearby; Left Controller Baisha dispatched Dingxi elite troops and Longgu Vice Commander Bao Xiaocheng's Crimson-Winged-Wing army, and together drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Xia forces besieged Yanghen Stockade; Commander Dang Shichang engaged them. Wanyan Gou'er sent Commander Jiagu Rui to raid the Xia camp by night and lift the siege, but the enemy still camped nearby. Left Controller Baisha sent Dingxi elite troops and Longgu Vice Commander Bao Xiaocheng's Crimson-Winged-Wing army, and together they drove the Xia off.

sentences.zh: 八月，安定堡馬家平總押李公直敗夏兵三千。

translations.literal: In the eighth month at Anding Fort's Majiaping, Chief Commander Li Gongzhi defeated three thousand Xia troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month at Anding Fort's Majiaping, Chief Commander Li Gongzhi defeated three thousand Xia troops.

sentences.zh: 九月，都統羅世暉卻夏兵於克戎寨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Commander Luo Shihui repulsed Xia troops at Kerong Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Commander Luo Shihui repulsed Xia troops at Kerong Stockade.

sentences.zh: 興定二年三月，右都監慶山奴奏：「夏人有乞和意，保安、綏德、葭州得文報，乞複互市，以尋舊盟。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Xingding Right Controller Qingshannu memorialized: "The Xia show intention to beg peace; Bao'an, Suide, and Jia Prefectures have received written reports asking to restore mutual markets and seek the old alliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Xingding 2 Right Controller Qingshannu reported: "Xia appears willing to sue for peace; Bao'an, Suide, and Jia Prefectures have received written requests to restore mutual trade and renew the old alliance.

sentences.zh: 以臣觀之，此出於遵頊，非邊吏所敢專者。」

translations.literal: In your subject's view, this comes from Zunxian—it is not something border officials would dare decide on their own."
translations.idiomatic: In my view this comes from Zunxian himself—border officials would not dare decide such a matter on their own."

sentences.zh: 朝廷不以為然。

translations.literal: The court did not accept this.
translations.idiomatic: The court did not accept this.

sentences.zh: 五月，夏人入葭州，慶山奴破之于馬吉峰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Xia men entered Jia Prefecture; Qingshannu defeated them at Maji Peak.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Xia forces entered Jia Prefecture; Qingshannu defeated them at Maji Peak.

sentences.zh: 七月，犯龕谷，夾谷瑞、趙防敗之，追至質孤堡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they violated Longgu; Jiagu Rui and Zhao Fang defeated them and pursued to Zhigu Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they attacked Longgu; Jiagu Rui and Zhao Fang defeated them and pursued to Zhigu Fort.

sentences.zh: 三年閏月，夏人破通秦寨，提控納合買住擊敗之，自葭盧川遁去。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of the third year Xia men captured Tongqin Stockade; Controller Nahe Maizhu defeated them and they fled away along Jialu Stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month of the third year Xia forces captured Tongqin Stockade; Controller Nahe Maizhu defeated them and they fled along Jialu Stream.

sentences.zh: 華州元帥完顏合達出安寨堡至隆州，敗其兵二千。

translations.literal: Huazhou Marshal Wanyan Heda marched from Anzhai Fort to Long Prefecture and defeated two thousand of their troops.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou Marshal Wanyan Heda marched from Anzhai Fort to Long Prefecture and defeated two thousand Xia troops.

sentences.zh: 進攻隆州，克其西南，會暮乃還。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Long Prefecture, captured its southwest, and returned when evening came.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced on Long Prefecture, captured its southwest quarter, and withdrew at dusk.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔有司移文夏國。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month an edict ordered the responsible offices to send written communication to the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict ordered the responsible offices to send a formal dispatch to Xia.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，夏人犯鎮戎，金師敗績，夏人公移語不遜，詔詞臣草牒折之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year Xia men violated Zhenrong; Jin forces suffered defeat. The Xia official communication used disrespectful language; an edict ordered literary officials to draft a written reply refuting them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year Xia forces attacked Zhenrong and Jin suffered defeat. Xia's official dispatch used disrespectful language; an edict ordered court writers to draft a rebuttal.

sentences.zh: 四月，夏兵犯邊，元帥石盞合喜遇于鹿兒原，提控烏古論世顯以偏師敗之，都統王定複破其眾於新泉城。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Xia troops violated the border; Marshal Shizhan Hexi met them at Lu'er Plain; Controller Wugulun Shixian with a detached force defeated them, and Commander Wang Ding again broke their host at Xinquan City.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Xia troops raided the border; Marshal Shizhan Hexi met them at Lu'er Plain; Controller Wugulun Shixian routed them with a detached force, and Commander Wang Ding defeated their main body again at Xinquan City.

sentences.zh: 元帥慶山奴攻宥州，圍神堆府，穴其城，士卒有登者，援兵至，擊走之，斬首二千，俘百餘人，獲雜畜三千餘。

translations.literal: Marshal Qingshannu attacked You Prefecture, besieged Shendui Prefecture, tunneled into its walls, and some soldiers mounted the ramparts; relief troops arrived and they were driven off, with two thousand heads cut off, more than a hundred captives taken, and more than three thousand mixed livestock seized.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Qingshannu attacked You Prefecture and besieged Shendui Prefecture, tunneling into the walls until some soldiers scaled them. Relief troops arrived and Jin drove them off, taking two thousand heads, more than a hundred prisoners, and more than three thousand head of livestock.

sentences.zh: 八月，夏人陷會州，刺史烏古論世顯降，複犯龕谷，夾谷瑞連戰敗之，夏人乃去。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Xia men captured Huizhou; Prefect Wugulun Shixian surrendered. They again violated Longgu; Jiagu Rui defeated them in successive battles and the Xia then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Xia captured Huizhou; Prefect Wugulun Shixian surrendered. They attacked Longgu again; Jiagu Rui defeated them in successive battles and Xia withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔有司移文議和，事竟不克。

translations.literal: That month an edict ordered the responsible offices to send written communication to discuss peace; the matter in the end did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict ordered the responsible offices to negotiate peace by written dispatch; the effort ultimately failed.

sentences.zh: 夏人三萬自高峰鎮圍定西，刺史愛申阿失剌、提控烏古論長壽、溫敦永昌擊走之。

translations.literal: Thirty thousand Xia men from Gaofeng Town besieged Dingxi; Prefect Aishen Ashila and Controllers Wugulun Changshou and Wendun Yongchang drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty thousand Xia troops from Gaofeng Town besieged Dingxi; Prefect Aishen Ashila and Controllers Wugulun Changshou and Wendun Yongchang drove them off.

sentences.zh: 九月，夏人圍綏平寨、安定堡，未幾，陷西寧州，遂攻定西，烏古論長壽擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Xia men besieged Suiping Stockade and Anding Fort; before long they captured Xining Prefecture, then attacked Dingxi; Wugulun Changshou repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Xia besieged Suiping Stockade and Anding Fort; soon they captured Xining Prefecture and then attacked Dingxi; Wugulun Changshou repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 乃襲鞏州，石盞合喜逆戰，一日十余戰，乃解去。

translations.literal: They then raided Gong Prefecture; Shizhan Hexi met them in battle, fighting more than ten engagements in one day, and they then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They then raided Gong Prefecture; Shizhan Hexi met them in battle, fighting more than ten engagements in a single day before they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，詔樞密院議夏事，奏曰：「夏人聚兵境上，欲由會州入，已遣行省白撒伏兵險要以待之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year an edict ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to discuss Xia affairs; they memorialized: "Xia men are massing troops on the border and wish to enter by Huizhou; the Branch Secretariat Baisha has already been sent to set ambushes at strategic passes to await them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to discuss Xia affairs; they reported: "Xia is massing troops on the border and intends to enter through Huizhou; Branch Secretariat Baisha has already been sent to set ambushes at strategic passes.

sentences.zh: 鄜延元帥府伺便發兵以綴其後，足以無慮。」

translations.literal: The Fuyan Marshal's headquarters will watch for opportunity to send troops to harass their rear—this is sufficient to be without concern."
translations.idiomatic: The Fuyan Marshal's headquarters will strike their rear when opportunity arises—there is no cause for alarm."

sentences.zh: 二月，甯遠軍節度使夾谷海壽破夏兵於搜嵬堡。

translations.literal: In the second month Ningyuan Army Military Commissioner Jiagu Haishou defeated Xia troops at Souwei Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Ningyuan Army Military Commissioner Jiagu Haishou defeated Xia troops at Souwei Fort.

sentences.zh: 三月，複取來羌城。

translations.literal: In the third month Laicheng was recaptured.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Laicheng was recaptured.

sentences.zh: 十月，攻龕谷，白撒連敗之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month they attacked Longgu; Baisha defeated them repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they attacked Longgu; Baisha defeated them repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 元光元年正月，夏人陷大通城，複取之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanguang Xia men captured Datong City; it was then recaptured.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yuanguang 1 Xia captured Datong City; Jin then recaptured it.

sentences.zh: 三月，提控李師林敗夏兵於永木嶺。

translations.literal: In the third month Controller Li Shilin defeated Xia troops at Yongmu Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Controller Li Shilin defeated Xia troops at Yongmu Ridge.

sentences.zh: 八月，攻甯安寨，十月，攻神林堡，十二月，入質孤堡，提控唐括昉敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month they attacked Ning'an Stockade; in the tenth month they attacked Shenlin Fort; in the twelfth month they entered Zhigu Fort; Controller Tangguo Fang defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month they attacked Ning'an Stockade; in the tenth month Shenlin Fort; in the twelfth month they entered Zhigu Fort; Controller Tangguo Fang defeated them.

sentences.zh: 二年，遵頊使其太子德任來伐，德任諫曰：「彼兵勢尚強，不若與之約和。」

translations.literal: In the second year Zunxian sent his crown prince Deren to campaign; Deren remonstrated: "Their military strength is still formidable—it would be better to make peace with them."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Zunxian sent his crown prince Deren to campaign against Jin. Deren remonstrated: "Their armies are still strong—we would do better to negotiate peace."

sentences.zh: 遵頊笑曰：「是非爾所知也。

translations.literal: Zunxian laughed and said: "That is not for you to know.
translations.idiomatic: Zunxian laughed and said: "That is beyond your understanding.

sentences.zh: 彼失蘭州竟不能複，何強之有。」

translations.literal: They lost Lanzhou and could not even recover it—where is their strength?"
translations.idiomatic: They lost Lanzhou and could not even recover it—what strength do they have?"

sentences.zh: 德任固諫不從，乞避太子位，願為僧。

translations.literal: Deren firmly remonstrated but was not heeded; he begged to yield the crown prince's position and wished to become a monk.
translations.idiomatic: Deren remonstrated again but was not heeded; he asked to renounce the crown prince's position and become a monk.

sentences.zh: 遵頊怒，幽之靈州，遣人代將，會天旱不果。

translations.literal: Zunxian was angry, imprisoned him in Ling Prefecture, and sent another to command in his place; as it happened drought came and the campaign did not take place.
translations.idiomatic: Zunxian was enraged, imprisoned him in Ling Prefecture, and sent another to command in his stead; drought intervened and the campaign did not take place.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大元兵問罪夏國，延安、慶原元帥府欲乘夏人之困弊伐之，陝西行省白撒、合達以為不可，乃止。

translations.literal: That year Great Yuan troops called Xia to account; the Yan'an and Qingyuan Marshal's headquarters wished to take advantage of the Xia's exhaustion to campaign against them, but Shaanxi Branch Secretariat Baisha and Heda held it could not be done, and the matter was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: That year Great Yuan forces moved against Xia. The Yan'an and Qingyuan Marshal's headquarters wished to strike Xia while they were exhausted, but Shaanxi Branch Secretariat Baisha and Heda objected and the plan was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 隴安軍節度使完顏阿鄰日與將士宴飲，不治軍事，夏人乘之，掠民五千余口、牛羊雜畜數萬而去。

translations.literal: Long'an Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Alin daily feasted and drank with officers and men and did not attend to military affairs; the Xia took advantage of this and carried off more than five thousand civilians and tens of thousands of cattle, sheep, and mixed livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Long'an Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Alin spent his days feasting with his officers and neglected military affairs. Xia took advantage and carried off more than five thousand civilians and tens of thousands of cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 自天會議和，八十餘年與夏人未嘗有兵革之事。

translations.literal: From the peace concluded at Tianhui, for more than eighty years there had never been warfare with the Xia.
translations.idiomatic: From the peace concluded at Tianhui, Jin and Xia had gone more than eighty years without war.

sentences.zh: 及貞祐之初，小有侵掠，以至構難十年不解，一勝一負精銳皆盡，而兩國俱弊。

translations.literal: By the beginning of Zhenyou there were small raids, leading to ten years of unresolved hostility; victory and defeat alternated until elite forces were exhausted on both sides and both states were worn down.
translations.idiomatic: By the beginning of Zhenyou there were small raids, leading to ten years of unresolved hostility. Victory and defeat alternated until both sides had exhausted their best troops and both states were worn down.

sentences.zh: 是歲，遵頊傳位於子德旺。

translations.literal: That year Zunxian transmitted the throne to his son Dewang.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zunxian abdicated in favor of his son Dewang.

sentences.zh: 正大元年，和議成，自稱兄弟之國。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengda peace was concluded, and they styled themselves brother states.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengda 1 peace was concluded, and the two states styled themselves brothers.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，遵頊死，七月，德旺死，嗣立者史失其名。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year Zunxian died; in the seventh month Dewang died; the name of the successor is lost to history.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year Zunxian died; in the seventh month Dewang died; the name of his successor is lost to history.

sentences.zh: 明年，夏國亡。

translations.literal: The following year the Xia state perished.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Xia state perished.

sentences.zh: 先是，夏使精方匭匣使王立之來聘，未複命國已亡，詔於京兆安置，充宣差彈壓，主管夏國降戶。

translations.literal: Earlier, Xia envoy Jingfang Guiqiashi Wang Lizhi had come on a mission of courtesy; before he could report back his state had perished. An edict ordered him settled in Jingzhao, appointed as special commissioner for suppression, in charge of Xia surrendered households.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Xia envoy Jingfang Guiqiashi Wang Lizhi had come on a diplomatic mission; before he could report home his state had fallen. An edict settled him in Jingzhao as special commissioner for suppression, in charge of Xia surrendered households.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，立之妻子三十余口至環州，詔以歸立之，賜以幣帛。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year more than thirty members of Lizhi's wife and children reached Huan Prefecture; an edict ordered them returned to Lizhi and bestowed silks and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year more than thirty members of Lizhi's family reached Huan Prefecture; an edict reunited them with Lizhi and bestowed silks and cloth.

sentences.zh: 立之上言，先世本申州人，乞不仕，居申州。

translations.literal: Lizhi submitted a memorial saying his forebears were originally from Shen Prefecture; he begged not to hold office and to reside in Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lizhi memorialized that his ancestors were originally from Shen Prefecture; he asked to decline office and live in Shen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔如所請，以本官居申州，主管唐、鄧、申、裕等處夏國降戶，聽唐、鄧總帥府節制，給上田千畝、牛具農作雲。

translations.literal: An edict granted his request; he was to reside in Shen Prefecture in his present office, supervising Xia surrendered households in Tang, Deng, Shen, Yu, and other places, subject to the Tang-Deng Marshal's headquarters, and was given a thousand mu of superior fields, oxen, farm tools, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted his request; he was to live in Shen Prefecture in his present office, supervising Xia surrendered households in Tang, Deng, Shen, Yu, and elsewhere under the Tang-Deng Marshal's command, with a grant of a thousand mu of superior fields, oxen, and farm tools.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：夏之立國舊矣，其臣羅世昌譜敘世次稱，元魏衰微，居松州者因以舊姓為托跋氏。

translations.literal: The encomium says: The founding of Xia is ancient. His minister Luo Shichang, in a genealogical account of successive generations, states that when Northern Wei declined, those dwelling at Song Prefecture took their old surname and became the Tuoba clan.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: Xia's founding is ancient. Minister Luo Shichang's genealogical account states that when Northern Wei declined, those dwelling at Song Prefecture took their old surname and became the Tuoba clan.

sentences.zh: 按《唐書》党項八部有托跋部，自党項入居銀、夏之間者號平夏部。

translations.literal: According to the Book of Tang, among the eight Tangut tribes there was the Tuoba tribe; those Tangut who entered and dwelt between Yin and Xia were called the Pingxia tribe.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Book of Tang, among the eight Tangut tribes was the Tuoba tribe; those Tangut who settled between Yin and Xia were called the Pingxia tribe.

sentences.zh: 托跋思恭以破黃巢功賜姓李氏，兄弟相繼為節度使，居夏州，在河南。

translations.literal: Tuoba Sigong, for merit in defeating Huang Chao, was granted the surname Li; brothers succeeded one another as military commissioners, dwelling at Xia Prefecture south of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoba Sigong received the surname Li for defeating Huang Chao; brothers succeeded one another as military commissioners, dwelling at Xia Prefecture south of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 繼遷再立國，元昊始大，乃北渡河，城興州而都之。

translations.literal: Jiqian re-established the state; Yuanhao first made it great, then crossed the river northward, walled Xing Prefecture, and made it his capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jiqian re-established the state; Yuanhao first made it great, then crossed the river northward, walled Xing Prefecture, and made it his capital.

sentences.zh: 其地初有夏、綏、銀、宥、靈、鹽等州，其後遂取武威、張掖、酒泉、燉煌郡地，南界橫山，東距西河，土宜三種，善水草，宜畜牧，所謂涼州畜牧甲天下者是也。

translations.literal: Their territory at first had Xia, Sui, Yin, You, Ling, Yan, and other prefectures; afterward they took the commandery lands of Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, and Dunhuang. Their southern border was Heng Mountain and their eastern limit the Western River. The soil suited three crops; grass and water were good and animal husbandry thrived—it was what was called the finest pasturage under Heaven in Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Their territory initially comprised Xia, Sui, Yin, You, Ling, Yan, and other prefectures; later they seized Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, and Dunhuang. Their southern border was Heng Mountain and their eastern limit the Western River. The soil supported three crops; grass and water were abundant and animal husbandry thrived—hence the saying that Liangzhou pasturage was finest under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 土堅腴，水清冽，風氣廣莫，民俗強梗尚氣，重然諾，敢戰鬥。

translations.literal: The soil was firm and fertile, the water clear and pure, the winds wide and desolate; the people's customs were tough and spirited, valuing sworn promises and daring in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The soil was firm and fertile, the water clear and pure, the winds harsh and wide; the people were tough and proud, honoring their word and bold in battle.

sentences.zh: 自漢、唐以水利積谷食邊兵，興州有漢、唐二渠，甘、涼亦各有灌溉，土境雖小，能以富強，地勢然也。

translations.literal: From Han and Tang onward they used waterworks to store grain and feed border troops; Xing Prefecture had the Han and Tang canals, and Gan and Liang each had irrigation as well. Though their territory was small, they could be rich and strong—such was the advantage of their terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Since Han and Tang they had used irrigation to store grain and feed border troops; Xing Prefecture had the Han and Tang canals, and Gan and Liang each had irrigation works. Though their territory was small, they could grow rich and strong—such was the advantage of their land.

sentences.zh: 五代之際，朝興夕替，制度禮樂，蕩為灰燼，唐節度使有鼓吹，故夏國聲樂清厲頓挫，猶有鼓吹之遺音焉。

translations.literal: In the age of the Five Dynasties regimes rose in the morning and fell by evening; institutions, rites, and music were swept to ashes. Tang military commissioners had wind and percussion ensembles, so Xia state's music was clear, sharp, and abruptly broken, yet still bore traces of those ensemble sounds.
translations.idiomatic: In the Five Dynasties era regimes rose and fell overnight; institutions, rites, and music were reduced to ashes. Tang military commissioners had wind and percussion ensembles, so Xia music was clear, sharp, and abrupt, yet still bore traces of those ensemble traditions.

sentences.zh: 然能崇尚儒術，尊孔子以帝號，其文章辭命有可觀者。

translations.literal: Yet they could honor Confucian learning, revering Confucius with an imperial title; their documents and edicts had passages worth noting.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they honored Confucian learning and revered Confucius with an imperial title; their documents and edicts contain passages worth reading.

sentences.zh: 立國二百餘年，抗衡遼、金、宋三國，偭鄉無常，視三國之勢強弱以為異同焉。

translations.literal: Established as a state for more than two hundred years, they contended with Liao, Jin, and Song, shifting allegiance without fixed rule, adjusting their stance according to which of the three states was strong or weak.
translations.idiomatic: For more than two hundred years they contended with Liao, Jin, and Song, shifting allegiance without fixed loyalty, adjusting their stance according to which of the three powers was ascendant.

sentences.zh: 故近代學者記西北地理，往往皆臆度言之。

translations.literal: Therefore scholars of recent times who recorded the geography of the northwest often spoke from mere conjecture.
translations.idiomatic: Thus scholars of recent times who recorded northwestern geography often spoke from mere conjecture.

sentences.zh: 聖神有作，天下會於一，驛道往來視為東西州矣。

translations.literal: When the sage and divine arose, all under Heaven was united as one; post roads ran back and forth and the region was regarded as eastern and western provinces alike.
translations.idiomatic: When the sage sovereign arose, all under Heaven was united; post roads ran east and west and the region was treated as provinces of a single realm.
